summary.text:
Let me evaluate each pair.

V05: Candidate matches reference closely — same layout, breadcrumbs, thumbnails, main image, right panel. Candidate appears slightly zoomed (left edge of text cut off — "IKEA Family price" shows "Family price", content shifted right, main image larger). Actually candidate's right panel text is clipped at left ("TA", "age combination"). This suggests slightly different scale/crop. Structure, images, hierarchy match. Some scaling difference. 0.75 seems right — key layout correct, only minor local differences. Could argue 1 if it's just screenshot scaling. The candidate image appears zoomed ~1.15x causing left clipping of text. The instructions say compare at same scale after compression. Scaling differences shouldn't be penalized much. Layout matches: thumbnails, main image, price, variants, breadcrumb. But candidate missing "All media"/"View in 3D" buttons (image ends before, but may be below fold). Reference shows them at bottom. Candidate bottom shows "Add to bag" partially. Also candidate missing the heart icon top-right? Hard to tell due to crop. I'll give 0.75 due to minor differences (missing visible All media buttons region, slight zoom/clipping).

Actually the reference shows All media/View in 3D buttons below main image; candidate screenshot at same viewport doesn't show them, but content ordering seems same, just scale. I'll score 0.75.

V06: Reference: modal with header bar visible (black top bar), close X top right, tabs All media/Video/Measurement, image grid with product image and lifestyle image, scrollbar right. Candidate: same tabs, same two images, close X, but modal appears taller covering header (page header partially visible behind), no black top bar visible — actually candidate top shows IKEA nav behind modal. The candidate modal shows additional grid rows below (more images). Reference shows scrollbar on right of modal; candidate shows grid continuing. Differences are minor — modal position/size slightly different, candidate shows 4 images vs reference shows 2 with empty white space below. Reference has large empty space below the two images. Candidate fills with more images. That's a layout difference in the grid. Still, same state, key layout correct. 0.75.

Hmm, reference shows mostly white empty area under the two images; candidate shows two more rows of images. This could be scroll position or actual content difference. Also reference modal has scrollbar. I'd say 0.75 — same state, key layout correct, local differences.

V07: Reference: tabs Overview/Product details/Measurements/What's included, component cards 1x Frame, 4x Shelf, 2x Leg, 1x Support leg, right big product image. Candidate: same tabs, same four component cards with same images/text/article numbers, right big image. Differences: candidate shows different content above tabs (assembly offer, points, return policy vs reference's price-drop/Afterpay/Visa card and the lifestyle image with All media buttons). Candidate doesn't show the gallery strip at top. But the criteria focus on tab, component cards, right image, hierarchy — those match well. Candidate's scroll position differs (missing the gallery thumbnails at top). Cards match closely. 0.75 or 1. The top portion differs significantly (reference shows image gallery + payment info; candidate shows assembly/returns info). But per criteria "横向标签、六种组件图文、数量、右侧大图和层级" — main elements match. Note criteria mentions 六种组件 (six components) but both show only 4 visible (scroll cut). I'll give 0.75 due to missing top gallery section / different scroll context, but the component tab content itself matches well. Actually comparing the tab section itself: nearly identical. The difference is just scroll offset showing different content above. Slight differences: candidate card images of Frame differ slightly (candidate frame image shows front view vs reference open frame?). Reference frame thumb shows open box frame; candidate shows front cabinet view. Minor. 0.75.

Could be 1? "主要结构、比例、图片、层级和样式吻合" — main structure matches. The missing gallery top is due to scroll. I'd say 0.75 to be safe given frame thumbnail image differs and top context differs.

V08: Candidate matches reference very closely: same layout, big leg images, thumbnails, price $8/2 pack, variants, quantity stepper, Add to bag, points, return info. Differences: review count (123) vs reference (867) — minor text. Reference shows regular price layout same. Candidate missing? Reference shows "Collect 8 points" same. Very close. Slight scale difference. Score 1 or 0.75. Layout, images, hierarchy all match. Review count difference is trivial data. I'd give 1. Maybe 0.75 for the zoom difference again — candidate appears slightly zoomed like V05. Everything matches though: breadcrumb, thumbnails, main image, right panel, stepper, add to bag. I'll give 1... but the slight scale shift (candidate content slightly larger) — under "整体截图压缩到同尺度后比较" we rescale, so fine. Give 1.

Actually V05 also could be 1 after rescaling? In V05, candidate's right panel is clipped at left — text cut mid-glyph ("TA" instead of "BESTÅ"). That's a rendering artifact — the panel appears partially cut off horizontally, meaning layout issue where right column overflows. After rescaling, reference shows full text with margins. Candidate's text being clipped indicates a proportional/overflow difference. That's a visible defect → 0.75.

Similarly V08 candidate right panel is fully visible, no clipping. So V08=1, V05=0.75.

Wait, in V08 candidate, right panel fully visible, yes. But is there heart icon top right? Reference has heart icon near title; candidate doesn't show heart icon? Reference shows heart at top-right of panel area. Candidate doesn't seem to show it... Looking at candidate V08, no heart icon visible next to STUBBARP. Hmm, reference has heart at (1355,225). Candidate — not visible. Minor icon difference. Still main structure matches → could still be 1? "主要结构、比例、图片、层级和样式吻合" — a missing small heart icon is a minor local difference → 0.75 maybe. I'll give 1 for V08 anyway? Let me be consistent: V08 everything else matches precisely. Missing heart icon is minor. 0.75 = "同状态关键布局正确，仅少量局部差异" fits well. I'll give V08 0.75.

Hmm, but that seems harsh for near-perfect match. The anchors: 1 = main structure/proportion/images/hierarchy/style match. A tiny icon missing doesn't violate that. But the review count differs (867 vs 123) — data difference. I'll give 1 for V08. Actually heart icon — reference has it, candidate lacks. Also candidate "View in 3D"/"All media" buttons present. I'll settle on 1 for V08, 0.75 for V05 (clipping defect), 0.75 V06, 0.75 V07.

Let me reconsider V06: reference modal: black header visible above modal, modal below it. Candidate: modal starts at top overlapping header, page header visible behind/above modal edges. Close X position: reference X at top right of modal (below header); candidate X also top right. Tabs centered in both. Grid: reference 2 images with whitespace below; candidate 4+ images filling. This is a noticeable content/scroll difference. But likely reference just at different scroll or lazy-load. Key layout correct, local differences → 0.75.

V07: 0.75.
